Safety meetings shall be held daily at the beginning of each shift to discuss the day’s activities, review the AHA for the activities, and discuss safety issues from the previous day’s work. The safety meeting shall be documented on SAW Form 4 (to be provided post award) and provided to the COR every Monday morning. The COR shall be a part of the safety meeting either in person or by phone. The Contractor performing a definable feature of work (DFOW) necessary for completion of the contract shall prepare and submit an AHA (reference ENG Form 6206) for each DFOW for review and acceptance by the Contracting Officer or their Designated Representative. The AHA is a documented risk management process by which the steps required to accomplish a work activity/task are outlined and the actual/potential hazards and controls are identified. Each work activity/task shall include a Risk Assessment Code (RAC). ENG Form 6206 may be utilized for the AHA. Similar tools are Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) and Job Safety Analysis (JSA). Review of AHAs will be conducted by the COR/CDSO and the Safety Office and may be submitted as part of the APP. The Contractor shall submit a Mon

nd the review will be completed within 10 days after submission. Acceptance of this plan shall be obtained before starting work. Written Programs that may be required as part of the Accident Prevention Plan. 1. E xposure Control Plan 2. Hearing Conservation Program (if hazardous noise is expected to occur) 3. Hazard Communication Plan 4. Thermal Stress Management Plan 5. Assured Equipment Grounding Conductor Program (not required if GFCI is utilized) 6. Standard Lift Plan (if load handling equipment is utilized) The APP shall interface with the Contractor’s overall safety and health program, and the Contractor shall include any portions referenced in the APP in the applicable APP element and made site specific. The Government considers the Prime Contractor to be the “controlling authority” for all work site safety and health of the Sub-Contractors. Query/clarification dates are never accepted as submission deadlines. Missing/ambiguous submission evidence remains review-required before FINAL_SUPER_GREEN.

items.review_contract: Gate-ready authoritative DCE evidence pack from the current DCE generation. Unknown is never PASS. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN requires every mandatory gate resolved and authoritative deadline reconciliation.

ranking_contract: Recall-first discovery; post-DCE SPM-fit reranking only. Approximately 80% priority lane + 20% evidence-quality exploration lane. No candidate is declared eligible by this rank.
instruction: Review SPM_PRIORITY HOT/GOOD items first, then exploration. These are authoritative DCE evidence packs, not final verdicts. Unknown is never PASS.
